method: Hand-authored event log. Every event traces to a fact recorded in models.json (what_changed), data/v1/model-updates.md, or this wave's own pricing-table changes. Price events carry a before/after pair only where the record documents both numbers; otherwise the fields are null and the summary says why. The pricing baseline below is the pricing table as curated on 2026-10-11 — the drift engine diffs the live table against it, so a rate that moves from here on is caught mechanically, not by memory.

pricing_baseline.label: Pricing table as curated 2026-10-11 (Watchtower Wave A)

events.summary: Midjourney V1 Video launched: image-to-video only, 5s clips extendable to 21s, no native audio. Still the current Midjourney video model — no V2 announced as of Oct 2026.
Soul Cinema launched as a preview: one-click cinematic stills for image-to-video pipelines. Per-image pricing was not published at launch and still is not — the record stays verify-live.
PixVerse V6 launched with native audio in the same pass, 1–15s clips at up to 1080p, and 20+ prompt-driven camera controls. Sibling C1 followed on April 7 for action and VFX work.

Wan 2.7 launched (Tongyi Lab): Thinking Mode — the model plans the composition before generating — with the four-endpoint suite wan2.7-t2v, wan2.7-i2v, wan2.7-r2v, wan2.7-videoedit at 2–15s, 720p/1080p, and native audio. The last 2.x generation before Wan 3.0.
OpenAI closed the Sora apps and website. The API kept running for five more months — a staged shutdown, not a single date. New work should not have been planned on it from this day.
Grok Imagine Video 1.5 went GA with native audio in one pass. A July 31 update added 1080p, text-to-video, voice reference, and 7-reference scene control.
Kling 3.0 Turbo went GA with audio always on: $0.112/s at 720p, $0.14/s at 1080p on the API ladder.

MiniMax H3 (alias Hailuo 3.0) released as the new flagship: omni-modal context, 2K clips of 4–15s, native stereo audio. Hailuo 02 / 2.3 became the legacy generation the same day. Open weights were announced 'in the coming days' — no public repo confirmed as of Oct 11.
FLUX 3 Video reached the public (announced July 23): Black Forest Labs' first video model, up to 20s single takes at native 1080p with multilingual audio and lip-sync.
FLUX Video Upscale shipped: 1.5–3x upscaling to 4K for clips up to 20s.

Wan 3.0 formally released (public beta since August 6): native 30-second generations at 30fps — not stitched clips — with native audio. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio list: $0.05/s at 480p, $0.10/s at 720p, $0.20/s at 1080p. Third-party resync notes the same month report a ~38% cut on base 3.0 since launch; no absolute launch card was published, so the guide records the cut as reported, not as a rate.

gemini-omni-1.1-flash went GA: scene extension to 40s in 10s steps, first/last-frame interpolation, a 360p–4K ladder, and stateful multi-turn editing. In the Gemini app, Omni 1.1 Flash replaces Veo 3.1; the Veo API continues separately.
H3 Max gained native 1080p and a Turbo tier, per Krea's September 9 changelog. Single secondary source — the guide's H3 figures stay unchanged until a second confirmation lands.

Black Forest Labs listed QHD at $0.40/s and UHD at $0.80/s, with video-to-video at $0.65/s (QHD) and $0.95/s (UHD). These tiers were documented in the guide's model record but missing from its pricing table until Watchtower 2.0 added them.

Vidu S2 official details confirmed: S2-Avatar runs real-time at 720p (up from S1's 540p) with mid-session reference-image swaps and live-stream editing. A different product class from rendered clips — budget it differently.
Mirage Tesseract launched: an agent-driven editing and motion-graphics suite, not a generation model. The local engine is free; it lives in the guide's edit/post lane.

The Sora 2 API and /v1/videos shut down, completing the discontinuation that began with the April app closures. Routes return 410 — they do not come back. The record stays in the guide for the historical record only.

Kling 4.0 announced: Flash early access for Ultra Yearly subscribers, full release promised 'this October' — a month, not a date. No GA model ID, no API pricing, no independent benchmarks as of Oct 11. Status stays announced; do not plan shoots on it.
The gemini-omni-flash-preview endpoint was deprecated and now 404s with no fallback. Anything still calling the preview ID is broken; the GA 1.1 Flash ID is the live one.
Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite listed on Venice at a $0.04/clip entry point, ahead of the tier's full API rollout in early October.

Luma's legacy models (Ray 3, Ray 2, Ray 2 Flash, Ray 2 Relaxed, Ray 3 Reference, Ray 3 Refiner) hit their retirement deadline on the legacy API. Ray 3.2 on the Luma Agents API is the migration target; ComfyUI v0.39.0 deprecated its Ray 2 nodes in the same window.

BytePlus official rates re-read and confirmed — no change: $0.1028/s at 480p, $0.2311/s at 720p, $0.5686/s at 1080p. A confirmation is recorded as an event because budgets were built on these numbers; if they move, this is the baseline they move from.
Vidu Q4 Preview launched: cinematic 4K 10-bit, up to 15 image references, 16s maximum clips, image-to-video and reference-to-video only (no text-to-video).

The $0.014/s launch headline was a promotional off-peak floor, not a list rate. The official October 7 rate card lists $0.045/s at 540p, $0.12/s at 1080p, and $0.39/s at 4K, with image-to-video and reference-to-video at a 30% discount through November 30. The guide budgets from the list rates.

vivago R1 made available globally: a conversational production agent (script, storyboard, generation, edit in one run, up to 5-minute videos). Single-source launch coverage and no published rate card — verify live before planning around it.

Every record in the guide re-verified against October 2026 coverage. The automated check feed covered 22 models and flagged 0 changes and 0 errors. 'Veo 4' was re-verified as search bait for the third time: no announcement, no model card, no API ID exists.
